device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (coderos-4080), shared with idle pylon-psionic (1.6 GB) and desktop apps
method: fixtures/clef/tools/bench_latency.py: one warmup, then N timed POST /v1/systemone calls on localhost, each with a fresh nonce line at the start of the state (no prefix reuse); median reported. Prompts: the 1k/4k/16k synthetic support-log requests from the clef-self-host prefill benchmark (3 questions: noul, choice, score). Psionic and llama.cpp measured back to back in one session.

commands.llama.cpp: llama-server (b11538 cuda-12.8 release) -m Clef-Flash-Q4_K_M.gguf --port 18093 -ngl 99 -np 1 -fa on --alias clef-flash -c 17408 -b 17408 -ub 17408

long_prompts_psionic_f16.note: --decision-max-tokens 65536; out_of_training_distribution: true; llama.cpp needs one physical batch of the whole prompt

process_vram_mib.note: nvidia-smi per-process, includes the CUDA context

split_16k_f16: from PSIONIC_CLEF_PROFILE / PSIONIC_CLEF_SKIP runs: GEMMs ~1.15 s, weight dequant ~0.2 s, Gated DeltaNet scan + conv + norms ~0.7 s, attention ~0.45 s, head ~0.015 s
